**Hello and welcome!**

I am a biologist by training (yes, I know how pipetting goes and what is the usual composition of a PCR  reaction) who developed an interest into genomics early on. Any kind of "-omics" goes hand in hand with big data, data analyses and visualisations. Here it was - my new passion and further career developments until my current role of a *Scientist* at Resolve Biosciences (Monheim, Germany).
:::
